column_description: A TEXT primary key uniquely identifying each clinical encounter record in the mental health database.
Timestamp recording the exact date and time when the clinical encounter occurred in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format.
Foreign key referencing AssessmentBasics(AB_Key), linking the encounter to a specific assessment when applicable.
Foreign key referencing Patients(Pat_Key), linking the encounter to the specific patient.
Identifier for the clinician who conducted this encounter (local reference, not foreign key).
Identifier for the facility where this encounter took place (local reference, not foreign key).
Number of appointments missed by the patient prior to or following this encounter.

Treatment barriers identified during this encounter. Contains values: 'multiple', 'time', 'financial', 'Transportation'. Contains noise with mixed case variations like 'MULTIPLE', 'FiNAncIal', 'TRAnsPorTATiON', 'FINANCIAL', 'TIME', 'TRANSPORTATION'. Contains NULL when treatment barriers are not assessed.
Date of the next scheduled appointment following this encounter, stored as text with dd/mm/yyyy format like '21/02/2025', '18/04/2025', '13/04/2025'.
Data quality score for this encounter record, indicating completeness and accuracy of documentation.
Assessment completeness indicator for this encounter. Contains standard completeness values.
